id.description: The Gemini API model id, exactly as the API expects it, e.g. 'gemini-3.8-flash'.

enabled.description: false keeps the settings on file but leaves the model out of the rotation (it can still be forced with --models).

requestsPerMinute.description: Request pacing for this model — at or below its per-minute request quota.

reasoning.description: Gemini thinkingLevel ('minimal' is its floor) — reasoning tokens count against quota, and classifying from a name + one line rarely needs more than 'low'.

overloadRetries.description: Same-model retries on an overload error (5xx) before moving on to the next model. 0 when failed requests count against the daily quota (observed on Gemini's free tier).

reason.description: Why this model is in the list, at this position, with these settings — so a later edit knows what it's trading off.

title: Enrich: LLM models
description: The Gemini models `pnpm classify-llm` rotates through, in priority order, with per-model batch size, pacing, reasoning effort, and overload-retry settings tuned to the free-tier quota.
